newsitem.title: USA: AMRE to file for Chapter 11 protection.
newsitem.headline: AMRE to file for Chapter 11 protection.

text.p: AMRE Inc said Friday it had ceased operations and planned to seek protection under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code.

AMRE said it has been unable to obtain additional working capital necessary to fund operating losses incurred in the fourth quarter, and it anticipates operating losses during the first quarter of 1997.
The company said it intends to complete all work in progress over the next few weeks and then execute an administrative liquidation of its assets.

AMRE said it is in discussions with a number of parties regarding a possible sale of certain assets, but it does not anticipate that any resulting transaction will yield any residual value for distribution to its stockholders.
Effective immediately, Ronald Bliwas, Dennis Bookshester, Murray Gross and Robert Swartz have resigned as directors of the company, AMRE said.
